notes: Ram plating: thick gunmetal plates, big bolt heads, dents, and a 3px amber-and-black hazard tape on every open edge (the leading edge). Fixed colours: do NOT multiply a tint over it. Autotile by 4-neighbour mask in SCREEN space (after rotating / mirroring the cell): column = N*1 + E*2 + S*4 + W*8, bit set when that neighbour is solid (a neighbour counts as solid when it covers the shared edge). Flat edges with a solid neighbour get the joint seam and rivets of walls.png; open flat edges get the near-black outline and lip; the cut edge (diagonal or arc) is always open and gets the same outline. The non-solid part is transparent: the game draws floor or space under it. Bits for sides where the cell has no flat edge are ignored (the frames repeat).
